lines.zh: 我踩雪不出声，雪替我收脚。
lines.en: I walk on snow without sound; the snow takes my steps.
The ice spikes are hard ground, and I know them.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪会合上。
lines.en: Where I pass, the snow closes again.
The wind pushes; I go with it.

lines.zh: 我从冰柱间穿过，不碰一根。
lines.en: I pass between ice pillars without touching one.

lines.zh: 我的脚印是浅的，很快没了。
lines.en: My prints are shallow and vanish fast.
The plains are empty; I walk straight.

lines.zh: 我踩到薄冰，会先听一声。
lines.en: On thin ice I listen for the crack first.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边撒魔法尘。
lines.en: I scatter magic dust as I walk.

lines.zh: 冷风把我的边角削圆了。
lines.en: Cold wind has rounded off my edges.
I walk slowly so as not to break the snow.

lines.zh: 这条雪路是我替人踩的。
lines.en: I tread this snow path for someone else.
I stand still and let snow fill my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我在等风停，风一停就暖。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to stop; then it warms.

lines.zh: 冰刺在响，那是它们在长。
lines.en: The ice spikes creak; that is them growing.

lines.zh: 我胸口的魔法尘在慢慢亮。
lines.en: The magic dust in my chest slowly brightens.
Don't worry; I will not melt.

lines.zh: 雪原上没有别人，只有我。
lines.en: There is no one on the plains but me.
I counted snowflakes all night.
Even with eyes shut, I feel the cold.
I am keeping watch on this snow for it.
The sky is too bright; the snow glares.

lines.zh: 我的手臂上又结了一层。
lines.en: Another layer has formed on my arms.
There are footsteps; I hear them.

lines.zh: 我把自己堆得更像人一点。
lines.en: I pile myself a little more into human shape.

lines.zh: 雪落进我嘴里，没有味道。
lines.en: Snow falls into my mouth and tastes of nothing.

lines.zh: 我把脚边的雪拢回原处。
lines.en: I gather the snow at my feet back into place.

lines.zh: 远处有雪块滑下来，很小一块。
lines.en: Somewhere far off, a small slab of snow slides down.
You are dressed far too thinly.

lines.zh: 我认得迷路的人的眼神。
lines.en: I know the look of someone lost.
Don't stand beneath the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 你睫毛上挂霜了，眨眼会疼。
lines.en: Frost hangs on your lashes; blinking will sting.

lines.zh: 我在冰柱后看了你一路。
lines.en: I watched you the whole way from behind the ice.

lines.zh: 你不是这里的人，脚印不对。
lines.en: You are not from here; your prints are wrong.

lines.zh: 你手里那盏灯，会引雪崩。
lines.en: That lantern in your hand could wake an avalanche.
I am waiting for you to ask the way.
Your lips are blue; come with me.
My eyes are two grains of ice.

lines.zh: 你踩在我昨天堆的雪上。
lines.en: You are standing on the snow I piled yesterday.
I look at you the way I look at light snow.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是这片雪的仆人。
lines.en: Don't fear; I only serve this snow.

lines.zh: 你身后那串脚印不是你的。
lines.en: The tracks behind you are not yours.
A chunk of snow fell off; it doesn't hurt.
You broke off my arm.

lines.zh: 我的魔法尘漏出来一点。
lines.en: A little magic dust is leaking out.
In snow, this wound will heal itself.
Stop hitting; I only keep the path.
Half of me is gone and I still stand.
Your blade is hot; my wound is melting.
I withdraw; the snow will fill me in.
The pain is the magic dust crackling.
I crouch, and the snow catches me.
I don't eat food; I eat the cold.
The bread is frozen hard; I can't bite it.

lines.zh: 你递来的热水，会烫化我。
lines.en: The hot water you offer would melt me.
A handful of snow is all I want.
The fire is too close; step back.
That apple froze solid; it looks lovely.
Your soup is steaming; it frightens me.

lines.zh: 给我一块冰，比什么都好。
lines.en: Give me a block of ice over anything else.
Don't bring that brazier in here.
I cup some snow and call it a meal.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会觉得像撞墙。
lines.en: Bump into me and it feels like a wall.
A little snow shook loose; it's fine.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气让我退开。
lines.en: The warmth off you makes me step back.
Don't lean on me; you'll catch a chill.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，你就不会滑倒。
lines.en: I steady you so you won't slip.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我的手指。
lines.en: That bump knocked off one of my fingers.
I shifted the snow a little to the side.
Your cloak brushed across my waist.
Crowd together like this and the snow melts.
Stand firm; the ice is very slick.

lines.zh: 雪之仆从不结伴，只服侍。
lines.en: Snow servants never pair; we only serve.

lines.zh: 我是被人堆出来的，没有亲族。
lines.en: I was piled up by hands; I have no kin.

lines.zh: 两个我站一起，会变成一个。
lines.en: Two of me side by side become one.
That is not something snow teaches me.
For a companion, head south.

lines.zh: 我只有一个任务，没有别的。
lines.en: I have one task and nothing else.

lines.zh: 我的胸口只有魔法尘，没有心。
lines.en: My chest holds magic dust, not a heart.
Don't speak of it to me; I'll come apart.
The sun took all my companions away.
I belong only to this snow.
My hands are all snow; my grip fails.
I can carry this block of ice.
Don't hand me iron; it feels too warm.
I scoop up snow and pack it small.

lines.zh: 你的东西沉，我的手指会断。
lines.en: Your things are heavy; my fingers would snap.
I move snow and touch nothing else.

lines.zh: 我怀里放不下任何东西。
lines.en: There is no room to hold anything in my chest.
Set it down; I have no use for it.
I hold it a moment and it freezes.
The hat you dropped, I picked it up for you.
You broke the snow cornice.
I grew these ice spikes; don't touch them.
You bring fire here; that won't do.
I hear the snow shouting.
You stepped onto the plains and I woke.
This cold is mine to keep watch over.
You are too warm; you must leave.

lines.zh: 我没生气，只是不能让你过去。
lines.en: I am not angry; I just can't let you pass.
The snowflakes have stopped at your feet.
You took another step forward.
I raise a hand and the snow gathers.

lines.zh: 你怀里的火种，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the ember you carry.

lines.zh: 这片雪认得我，不认得你。
lines.en: This snow knows me, not you.
Don't make me freeze you where you stand.

lines.zh: 你那火把，我一步都不挪眼。
lines.en: I will not take my eyes off that torch.

lines.zh: 风在我这边，雪也在我这边。
lines.en: The wind is with me, and so is the snow.

lines.zh: 你踩雪的声，一下比一下沉。
lines.en: Your steps in snow grow heavier each time.
You have backed against the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 雪在我脚边转，你看不见。
lines.en: Snow swirls at my feet, out of your sight.
I am in no hurry; the cold waits for me.
Your fire is dying down.
I have buried every path around you.
Don't look up; the ice spikes are moving.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气越来越短。
lines.en: Your breath clouds are getting shorter.
I am waiting for you to put down that lantern.

lines.zh: 雪落得慢，是因为我在压。
lines.en: The snow falls slowly because I hold it back.

lines.zh: 你只有一个人，我有整片雪原。
lines.en: You are one; I have the whole plain.
I won't strike; the cold strikes first.

lines.zh: 我往前走，脚印却先留给你。
lines.en: I walk forward, but my footprints appear behind you first.
One push and you sit down in the snow.
My hands are made of ice, and hard.

lines.zh: 这一下带着魔法尘的冷。
lines.en: This blow carries the cold of magic dust.
I strike not to kill but to drive you off.
Your fingers are the first to stiffen.
Ice spikes are rising out of the ground.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，你就慢半拍。
lines.en: One touch from me, and you slow half a step.
I drew the snow line; you crossed it.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，带着一冬的冷。
lines.en: This punch carries a whole winter's cold.

lines.zh: 你退回雪线外，我就收手。
lines.en: Step back past the snow line and I stop.
The snowy plains are full of my kind.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地一次来我一两个。
lines.en: The ice spikes send one or two of us.
When snow lies deep enough, I take shape.

lines.zh: 我不是被埋的，是被叫醒的。
lines.en: I was not buried; I was woken.

lines.zh: 这一夜风大，我来了两个。
lines.en: The wind was strong tonight; two of us came.

lines.zh: 我胸口那粒尘先亮起来。
lines.en: The grain of dust in my chest lit first.
I sit up out of the snowdrift.
Snow lies thin elsewhere; I cannot form there.
My companion and I were piled up together.
You came just as I opened my eyes.
The field of ice spikes is my home.
Only after the snow stopped did I dare rise.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着夜里的霜。
lines.en: Frost from the night still clings to me.

lines.zh: 这片雪原上，我不算稀奇。
lines.en: On these plains, I am nothing unusual.
One touch of fire and half of me melts.

lines.zh: 从冰刺上摔下，我碎了角。
lines.en: I fell from the ice spikes and chipped.
Water dissolves me; only dust remains.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹成一团雪雾。
lines.en: The blast blew me into a cloud of snow.

lines.zh: 箭在我胸口开了个透风的洞。
lines.en: The arrow left a drafty hole in my chest.

lines.zh: 魔法尘和外来的魔法在打架。
lines.en: My magic dust fights the magic that struck me.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，我只是没力气。
lines.en: I need no food; I am simply weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰刺上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the ice spikes and I flinched.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有雪，我会散掉。
lines.en: There is no snow in the void; I would scatter.
